text.description_html:
DETEX EAX-500MC65, Surface Mounted Door Alarm

DETEX EAX-500MC65 door alarm uses 9 volt battery - Easy to install with no wiring to run. Some applications include: restricted doors, emergency fire escape doors, nursing home stairwell doors, rear restaurant and theater doors.

The Stand Alone Surface Mount Door Alarm is a magnetic contact controlled door alarm. This means it is surface mounted to the door and a magnet is mounted on the door frame. When the door opens, the alarm sounds; and this is one loud alarm--sounding at over 100 decibels.

It can be put in one of two operating modes. The first is Always Armed, where the alarm will sound every time the door is opened. The second mode is ON/OFF; in this mode, the operator can manually arm or disarm the device with a key.

Features of the DETEX EAX-500MC65 Door Alarm:

  • Annunciator Feature (beeps when door opens).
  • Arming Delay Time: 15 seconds.
  • Self-contained and dual-tamper supervised.
  • Piezo siren that sounds at over 95db.
  • Easy to install: Self contained.
  • Low battery alert.
  • LED Status indicator on the front of the housing..

Specifications of the DETEX EAX-500MC65 Door Alarm:

  • Height:7.70" (19.56 cm)
  • Width: 2.10" (5.33 cm)
  • Projection: 2-3/8" (6.03 cm)
  • Color: Gray Finish
  • Lock Cylinder: 1-1/4" Mortise lock cylinder (Included).
  • Requires a 9V battery (Included).
  • DETEX EAX-500MC65 Installation Instructions (PDF)

*Set includes 9 volt battery, Mortise lock cylinder, Sensor kit, Red Warning Sign and installation screws.

Sold Individually
